متفرقات.title: Still here
متفرقات.description: One of today's clients was a person whose house I've inspected in the past. It happens every now and then, and I'm appreciating those meetings more and more with each passing year. It's not so much about the actual person. It's more about getting a sense of progression. A story unfolding instead of just a snapshot. It didn't use to be like that. Maybe it's age. A feeling of gratitude for having been able to stick around for another year. Still here. Thank you.
